title: Fix non VAL_ITEM related pointer-sign warnings on ASN.1 dissectors
description:
The VAL_ITEM warnings stem from, e.g., asn2wrs.py using the same
dissect_ber_integer function for both FT_INT32 and FT_UINT32 fields.

In the case of Kerberos, we're constrained because the kerberos
implementations (both MIT and Heimdal, thankfully) define
krb5_data.data to be a char* (even though it's treated as pure
octet data and not as a string.)
https://web.mit.edu/kerberos/krb5-devel/doc/appdev/refs/types/krb5_data.html

Ping #20175

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
